import collections,json,re,sqlite3
with open('packet.json') as f:
    packet=json.load(f)
conn=sqlite3.connect('file:database.sqlite?mode=ro',uri=True)
expressions={
    'document':'d.number', 'final_document':'d.number',
    'disposition':'di.code', 'wg_meeting':'m.label',
    'cr_pack':'p.pack_number', 'tsg_meeting':'p.tsg_meeting',
    'clause':'s.clause'
}
pack_joins='JOIN cr_in_pack cp ON cp.cr = d.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = cp.pack_id'
decision_joins='JOIN disposition di ON di.target = d.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id = di.resolution_id JOIN meeting m ON m.id = r.meeting_id'
section_joins='JOIN cr_modifies_section cs ON cs.cr = d.id JOIN section s ON s.id = cs.section_id'
verified=[\"di.evidence_status = 'source_verified'\", \"di.scope = 'whole_target'\", \"m.wg = 'RAN5'\"]
def literal(value):
    return \"'\"+value.replace(\"'\",\"''\")+\"'\"
records=[]
counts=collections.defaultdict(list)
for item in packet['items']:
    question=item['question']
    fields=item['fields']
    projection=', '.join(expressions[field]+' AS '+field for field in fields)
    cte=''
    source='document d'
    joins=[pack_joins]
    conditions=[]
    if fields == ['cr_pack','tsg_meeting']:
        family='pack_lookup'
        match=re.search(r'change request (R5-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS (["'^)]+)'"\\)',question,re.I)
        assert match,item['id']
        number,cr,spec=match.groups()
        conditions += ['d.number = '+literal(number),'d.cr_number = '+literal(cr),'d.spec = '+literal(spec)]
    elif fields in (['disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack','tsg_meeting'],['disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack','tsg_meeting','clause']):
        family='trace_clauses' if 'clause' in fields else 'decision_and_pack'
        match=re.search(r'change request (R5-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS (["'^)]+)'"\\)',question,re.I)
        assert match,item['id']
        number,cr,spec=match.groups()
        conditions += ['d.number = '+literal(number),'d.cr_number = '+literal(cr),'d.spec = '+literal(spec)]
        joins += [decision_joins]
        conditions += verified
        if 'clause' in fields:
            joins += [section_joins]
            conditions += ['s.spec = '+literal(spec)]
    elif fields == ['document','disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack']:
        family='release_and_clause'
        match=re.fullmatch(r'Which (Rel-\\d+) change requests that modify clause (\\S+) of TS (\\S+) have a source-verified RAN5 disposition for the whole document and were submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack\\? Give each document, its disposition, the RAN5 meeting, and the CR pack document number\\.',question)
        assert match,item['id']
        release,clause,spec=match.groups()
        joins += [decision_joins,section_joins]
        conditions += verified
        conditions += [\"d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'\",'d.target_release = '+literal(release),'d.spec = '+literal(spec),'s.spec = '+literal(spec),'s.clause = '+literal(clause)]
    elif fields == ['document','disposition','wg_meeting']:
        family='pack_members'
        match=re.fullmatch(r'TSG RAN CR pack (RP-\\d+) carries change requests from RAN5\\. For each change request in the pack that has a source-verified RAN5 disposition for the whole document, give the document, the disposition, and the RAN5 meeting\\.',question)
        assert match,item['id']
        joins += [decision_joins]
        conditions += verified
        conditions += [\"d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'\",'p.pack_number = '+literal(match.group(1))]
    elif fields == ['final_document','disposition','cr_pack']:
        family='revision_descendants'
        match=re.fullmatch(r'RAN5 recorded document (R5-\\d+) as revised\\. Follow its revisions to every later version that has a source-verified RAN5 disposition for the whole document and was submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack\\. Give each such document, that disposition, and the CR pack document number\\.',question)
        assert match,item['id']
        seed=literal(match.group(1))
        cte=('WITH RECURSIVE later_versions(id) AS ('
             'SELECT rv.later FROM revision rv JOIN document seed ON seed.id = rv.earlier WHERE seed.number = '+seed+' '
             'UNION SELECT rv.later FROM revision rv JOIN later_versions v ON rv.earlier = v.id) ')
        source='later_versions v JOIN document d ON d.id = v.id'
        joins += [decision_joins]
        conditions += verified
        conditions += ['d.number <> '+seed]
    else:
        raise ValueError(item['id'])
    sql=cte+'SELECT DISTINCT '+projection+' FROM '+source+' '+' '.join(joins)+' WHERE '+' AND '.join(conditions)+';'
    cursor=conn.execute(sql)
    assert [column[0] for column in cursor.description] == fields,item['id']
    rows=cursor.fetchall()
    assert len(rows)==len(set(rows)),item['id']
    counts[family].append((item['id'],len(rows)))
    records.append({'id':item['id'],'sql':sql})
assert len(records)==len(packet['items'])
with open('queries.jsonl','w') as f:
    for record in records:
        f.write(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False)+'\\n')
print('Lines written:',len(records))
print('All generated queries executed successfully with exactly the requested column names and order.')
for family,items in counts.items():
    print(family, 'items='+str(len(items)), 'row_count_range='+str((min(n for _,n in items),max(n for _,n in items))), 'empty='+str([i for i,n in items if n==0]))
